narrative: On the board. The sheets as they were on Wednesday, the two margin-marks unenlarged, no new speech under either. On the board. The vertical line in the margin of the pleasant speech. No words added beside it. The sheet for a parliament is still the blank one, face down at the side. On the board. The pen capped. No new leaf begun. The sheet for a parliament is still the blank one, face down at the side.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the marks, capped the pen, and stopped.

entities.name: Richard II
entities.context: Shown on draft in Still the marks
